story_description: A clear description of the user story and its value proposition.
task_description: A detailed description of what this specific task accomplishes.
atom_description: The smallest deliverable unit of work that provides value.
problem_statement: Describe the problem this atom solves and why it matters.
scope_in: What is included in this atom
assumptions: Prerequisite conditions that must be true
Dependencies that are assumed to exist
constraints: Technical constraints that must be honored
functional_requirements: First functional requirement - what the system must do
nonfunctional_requirements: Performance, reliability, or other quality attributes
data_model_changes: Add ExampleModel with fields: id, name, timestamp
ui_interactions: User clicks button to trigger action
failure_modes: Network failure - show error message and retry option
rollback_plan: Revert the changes in files_touched and restore previous behavior.

integration: Test end-to-end flow from UI to persistence
ui: Verify loading state appears during processing
perf: Verify response time under 100ms for typical input

acceptance_tests: Given valid input, when processed, then correct output is returned
completed_when: The feature works as specified and tests pass.
completed_evidence: CI test run showing green status and NewFile.swift compiles.
open_questions: Are there any edge cases we have not considered?
notes: This is a template atom for reference.

na_justifications.reviewers[0]: Template placeholder - real atoms must specify actual reviewers

verification_steps: Run swift build && swift test to verify compilation
Review code changes and verify acceptance criteria
